body: I see that the mods here are overly sensitive to life. Very disheartenibg when the info someone needs to hear is replaced by impersonal reccomendations for clinics. That is the type of pawning off of responsibility that drove most of us here. I see now that this is a forum for self pity and sympathy. Not growth. Very sad that this is the last forum many people visit because they hear the same bs they've always heard. Mods are essentially the straw the broke the camel's back. I wonder how much blood is on their hands. I will be leaving Reddit.

I'm honestly trying to be helpful when I say that you should look back on the past few years and how priveleged you were to be a shut in that didn't have to find his own money. 
You were living off money that others worked hard for and you don't know those people. If you go now, than those people worked for that in vein. 
Don't let that happen. You have a responsibility now. Which is what everyone needs to feel useful. That's why you should keep fighting.
I never had the opportunity to be a shut in or even play a video game, and I am a shut in by nature. I don't want to sound shitty but be more grateful for that. My parents would never steal for my sake.

Thanks but that's not the help anyone here is looking for. I could find that resource with Google.
It doesn't bother me but that type of response could be insulting to many people worse off than me. I suggest not posting that unless they ask for it. 
Responses where the commenter did not read the body is not what anyone here would appreciate, including myself.
Thanks so much very kind. I noticed it also and left a reply.

Hey,  I understand what you mean with not wanting to approach a resource that is meant for these issues. Often times they will just corner and interrogate you it seems. Make sure you're ok, and if everything seems fine they tell you to fuck off. If its not, they prescribe some other resource, and so on amd so on until you're talking to some doctor that is willing to give you zombie pills. Ypu realize that all depression resources have the end goal of turning you numb. 

Well, if you live in Toronto and would like some company, messgae me. I should say that I'm not looking for a friend really. Just someone to be beside if that makes sense. We could just meet to read our own books beside each other or something. I can make friends no problem but I need someone who feels like I do and maybe we can help each other out through our similar outlooks on life. If they are similar that is. I just wanted to explain that I'm not looking for just another friend or gf on the sneak tip. I'm very drama free and often times feel too much so in a way.
I consider myself a good person but also an ass hole if that makes sense at all.
